title: Magnolia's House Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Location Location Location! This 2 bedroom updated and recently renovated townhome is a 3 minute walk to the beach! Located in a private Seagrove community, Magnolia's House offers an updated kitchen, 2 bedrooms with balconies and sleeps 6!
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HI-LIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. - 2 parking spots available - 2 adult sized beach cruisers included - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Community grill - Fully stocked kitchen - Access to the community pool and tennis court - Short 5-minute walk to the beach, community pool, shopping, and dining - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ON: -**Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($100 fee applies at booking). Home Details: Flexible stays are available- minimum 2 nights. Location Location Location! This renovated 2-bedroom townhome is a 3-minute walk to the beach and is just steps away from the community pool! Located in the private Seagrove community of Cassine Gardens, Magnolia's House offers an updated kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, tile and hardwood flooring throughout, updated bathrooms, and 2 bedrooms each with their own private balcony! Magnolia's House is a corner unit just steps to the community pool. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 6) Second Floor: Bedroom 1: King bed, Flat Screen TV, ensuite bathroom, private balcony Bedroom 2: Dual Queen bed guest bedroom, Flat screen TV, private balcony Hallway bathroom IMPORANT DETAILS: 2 parking spots available with this rental 2 Complimentary Bikes Included Free WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
